propositions: Build and validate a one-time history-strip operational script using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) that removes .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from all historical revisions while preserving DAG topology and merge commits
The script must execute only on fresh unfiltered clones and refuse partial clones with blob:none filter, preventing fatal blob-not-found failures during fast-import
After rewrite, the rewritten branch must have identical commit and merge-commit counts as the original, identical tree at HEAD after dynamic re-add, and zero commits touching the removed prefixes

The script must dynamically derive the re-add set from git ls-tree instead of hardcoded lists and parse fast-export data blocks by byte length to preserve commit messages beginning with file-command bytes like M or D
A fresh unfiltered no-tags clone of the rewritten branch must have pack size at most 150 MB, with the protected tag pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z verified absent locally and unchanged on the remote
The dry-run script must perform zero remote pushes and leave both the source remote branch (refs/heads/tickets) and protected tag unchanged, with publication and tag deletion deferred to task A6-1
